text_block_list.text: The day of the Japanese Derby had finally arrived.

The venue's atmosphere, buzzing with excitement for the "BNW" three-way clash,
reached all the way into the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"First they made a big fuss about the 'Big Two,'
and now it's 'BNW'..."
choice_data_list: That's proof your abilities have been recognized.
It's proof that your ability has been recognized.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Recognized, you say... listen,
only the Satsuki Sho is over, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you're getting hyped up a bit right now,
people's opinions of you can flip in an instant."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, I mean, she's not the kind of opponent
I can beat if I get cocky anyway.

"As Narita Taishin mutters under her breath,
the person on her mind is without a doubt—"

He must be talking about Winning Ticket,
who is completely obsessed with becoming a 'Derby Umamusume.'

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"What I gotta do hasn't changed.
Win, and carve my run into everyone's memories."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Until then—I won't slack off for a second.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I'm heading out now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah--there you are, Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide.
...Where is she?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She hasn't arrived yet.
She probably plans to stay in the waiting room until the very last moment.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Did you notice?
Over the past few days, she's been—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
She was trying to avoid talking to us.
...Guess that's just her way of sharpening her focus.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh... As expected of Taishin.
You're very observant.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Someone that noisy suddenly going dead quiet is obviously gonna stick out.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Doesn't matter, though.
Because I'm the one who's gonna win."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I could say the exact same thing right back to you.
The second leg of the Classic Triple Crown route: the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby). The curtain finally rises on the "Clash of the Big Three"...!
